title: Repo Operations - FEDERAL RESERVE BANK of NEW YORK

source.name: Federal Reserve Bank of New York

summary: This is a landing page on the New York Fed's website describing the Federal Reserve's repo and reverse repo operations, which are conducted daily to maintain the federal funds rate within the FOMC's target range. The page serves as a directory to various resources including historical data, statements, policies, FAQs, and eligible securities schedules.
key_points: The New York Fed conducts repo and reverse repo operations each business day
These operations help keep the federal funds rate within the target range established by the FOMC
Operation results include all repo and reverse repo operations, including small value exercises
The page provides links to historical transaction data, statements and operating policies
Additional resources include FAQs on reverse repo and standing repo operations
A schedule of eligible securities for repo operations is available
why_it_matters: This page describes the Fed's market operations framework for repo transactions, which are fundamental to short-term funding markets and monetary policy implementation. Understanding this infrastructure is relevant for comprehending how the Fed conducts monetary policy and manages short-term rates.
market_structure_context: This page describes the New York Fed's repo and reverse repo operation framework—the mechanical process by which the Fed conducts open market operations to implement monetary policy. The operations target the federal funds rate and involve eligible securities. This is core market plumbing information.
